title: Spelling Corrector for Student Essays with Edit-Distance Candidates
description: Builds a spelling corrector using edit distance and word frequencies, then adds context from neighbouring words and measures how much context reduces wrong corrections of real words.

title: Meeting Minutes Action Item Extractor
description: Finds tasks, owners and due dates in meeting transcripts using rules and a small classifier, compares the two on hand-labelled transcripts and shows where each approach fails.

title: Question Answering over a University Handbook with Citations
description: Answers student questions from a handbook by retrieving passages and quoting them, refuses when no passage supports an answer and measures how often answers are wrong or unsupported.
